explanation: Requested point W=1.45 GeV, Q2=0.4 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.1, phi*=30 deg for the eta channel is physically impossible: W=1.45 GeV is below the e p -> e' p eta production threshold of 1.4861 GeV (set by m_p + m_eta). The Delta(1232) resonance region is irrelevant to this threshold, so being 'above the Delta' does not make the point valid. Preflight also confirms the eta lookup table only covers W in [1.4856, 6.0000] GeV, so the code would have to extrapolate the hadronic model even if forced to run. No physically meaningful correction (e.g., nudging W upward) was applied since that would silently change the requested kinematics; instead the request is refused. To proceed, choose W >= 1.4961 GeV (the first W on the validated table grid) or confirm the desired W value.
